A few service agencies for new immigrants that provide services to the Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town, and Taylor Massey areas. Services include settlement assistance (essential and affordable, information about life in Canada/Ontario, steps to obtain citizenship, assistance with filling out forms), housing assistance (home planning, affordable housing applications, access to rent bank, energy bill assistance), senior programs (Integrated Services for Seniors, personal support services), youth programs (such as billiards, after-school youth programs), employment services, language interpretation, and advice on women's health issues. The TNO Food Collaborative (run by The Neighbourhood Organization) provides free food access to thousands of individuals in the Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park communities, including fresh produce, eggs, and dairy products distributed twice a month, with year-round distribution supported by community partners like Greenwin Cares.

Multi-service settlement agency serving Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park, St. James Town and Taylor Massey. Services include settlement support (needs assessment, orientation to life in Canada/Ontario, citizenship preparation classes, immigration forms help), housing assistance (housing search, subsidized housing applications, rent bank access, energy bill assistance), seniors programs (Integrated Services for Seniors, personal support services), youth programs (e.g., after-school girls' programs), employment services, language training, and violence-against-women counselling. Timbrell Resource Centre. It participates in the Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) system with fee subsidies available; staff speak 9 languages including Arabic, Bengali, French, Hindi, and Persian, and meals are catered with halal, pork-free, peanut-free, vegan, and vegetarian options available.

ff411a340bcb.backTranslation: A community-based non-profit organization (established in 2018 for parents of children with autism and officially registered in 2020) that provides services to children and youth with autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders in East York, offering full-time and after-school care. These programs include the "Roots" programs for youth, which run from Monday to Saturday, summer respite and relaxation services, monthly parent support group meetings, after-school homework assistance, winter and March break camps for older children and youth, after-school programs, specialized workshops, and awareness campaigns about autism/disabilities.

Programs include Roots youth programs running Monday to Saturday, weekend respite, monthly parent support meetings, after-school homework support, free inclusive summer and March break camps, back-to-school events, educational workshops and autism/disability awareness campaigns.
ff411a340bcb.text: د خلکو په کچه یو غیرانتفاعي سازمان (چې په 2018 کال کې د اتیزم سره مخ شوي ماشومانو د والدینو لخوا تاسیس شو او په 2020 کال کې رسمي ثبت شول) چې په East York کې د اتیزم او نور عصبي-دماغي اختلالات سره مخ شوي ماشومان او ځوانانو ته وړیا، د ټولنې پر بنسټ او د کورنۍ په پام کې نیولو سره خدمات چمتو کوي. دغه پروګرامونه د ځوانانو د "Roots" پروګرامونه شامل دي چې له دوشنبه تر شنبې پورې ترسره کیږي، د اونۍ پای د آرامۍ او استراحت لپاره خدمات، د والدینو میاشتنی ملګري ملاتړ غونډې، د ښوونځي وروسته د کورنۍ دندې (homework) سره مرسته، وړیا او شامله د اوړي او مارچ رخصتي په ورځو ترسره شوې کمپونه، د ښوونځي بیا پیل په برخه کې پروګرامونه، زده کړې ورکشاپونه او د اتیزم/معلولیت په اړه د پوهاوی کمپاینونه دي.
